title: Tina Peters' Sentence Commuted by Governor Jared Polis
key_takeaways: Peters, who was employed as a county clerk, was arrested and charged with conspiracy to commit computer tampering and unlawful entry into a computer system.
The commutation has sparked mixed reactions from various stakeholders.

Advocates are working to ensure that she receives the support necessary to reintegrate successfully, while also addressing concerns about the long-term impact of her actions on public trust in elections.
